title: Resample route points
help: Short segments may be kept to preserve turns, stations and endpoints. Station details and existing elevation samples are retained.
mapHelp: Drag to pan, scroll to zoom. Changes are applied only when you choose Apply resampling.
done: Route points resampled. Undo restores the original route.
exceptionPosition: {current} / {total}, at {distance} km on the original route, spacing {spacing} m. {reason}
shape: Preserves the route shape or a turn.
options: Enter positive spacings with minimum ≤ maximum, and a nonnegative shape deviation.
route: The route needs at least two distinct positions and valid point associations.
limit: This preview exceeds the processing limit (up to 100,000 output points). Increase spacing or shape deviation, or process a shorter route.
failed: Could not calculate the preview. Try again.
